Messages.Author: Daniel Figueiredo Silva
Messages.Body:
Hi. I have recently ran into a doubt regarding the Serpentis action,
Temptaion. If I have gained control of one of my prey´s vampires via
Temptation, and before the end of my turn he is ousted, do I return the
vampire to the ousted Methuselah or do I keep it since I would not be able
to
return the vampire to it´s controller?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From Daniel Figueiredo Silva <om...@MailAndNews.com>
=====

>Hi. I have recently ran into a doubt regarding the Serpentis action,
>Temptaion. If I have gained control of one of my prey´s vampires via
>Temptation, and before the end of my turn he is ousted, do I return the
>vampire to the ousted Methuselah or do I keep it since I would not be able
>to
>return the vampire to it´s controller?

The effect isn't "during <time x> return hime to previous controller".
It's "you control him until <time x>". When your control ends, you
no longer control the vampire. At that point, the Methuselah who
*does* control him is out of the game, so he is burned.
